reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects proposal evaluation and automation.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction matches real-time inventory and reordering.

decisions.rationale: The parent is a distinct, documented outcome; its granularity is appropriate.
decisions.outcome_justification: Administrator manages inventory thresholds and replenishment—distinct from proposal evaluation.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction covers goods receiving, location assignment, and defect flagging.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects online shopping, payment, and tracking.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction matches ticket lifecycle and agent performance.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction omits strategic decision-making; focuses on report generation.
